title: Secondary Wholesaler: No New IV Fluid Volume

caller.name: Dana Kessler
caller.label: Account Rep, Secondary Wholesaler Customer Service (Des Moines)

transcript.speaker: Wholesaler Rep
transcript.text: Hi, this is Dana Kessler at customer service in Des Moines, calling back on your Prairie Ridge account. You left a message about IV fluids?

transcript.speaker: Purchasing Manager
transcript.text: Yes, thanks for getting back to me. Our primary just put us on forty percent for NS 1000s, LR and the 250 minibags. I need to know how much you can pick up.

transcript.speaker: Wholesaler Rep
transcript.text: Yeah, we heard about it too. Our phones have been ringing since six. As of this morning, NS 1000s, LR and the 250 minibags are on allocation for current customers only, based on what you bought from us over the past six months.

transcript.speaker: Wholesaler Rep
transcript.text: I pulled your history. You've bought almost none of those from us, so I can't add new volume. I can put you on the waitlist.

transcript.speaker: Wholesaler Rep
transcript.text: Today's 11:00 truck will have your normal order, but no IV fluids above what's already on it. I can't give you a date for when the waitlist opens up. Sorry. Do you want me to add you to the list now?

transcript.speaker: Wholesaler Rep
transcript.text: Okay. I'll send you an email confirming your spot on the waitlist. Good luck this week. I know everybody's in the same boat.

voiceStyles.Wholesaler Rep: Man in his 30s, friendly but rushed and apologetic, busy call center behind him
voiceStyles.Purchasing Manager: Calm, businesslike hospital buyer, a little tense

instructorNote: This call takes away the backup supplier, so the Purchasing Manager has to tell the Director of Pharmacy that the gap stays open and start a day-one loan request to Webster Valley Medical Center in Fort Dodge. Check that he keeps the waitlist spot, does not count on the 11:00 truck to add anything, and turns down any unsolicited vendor offer that lacks a lot list and a licensed chain of custody.
